Key Takeaways

  • Registration is what gives your purchase legal effect — an unregistered sale generally cannot prove ownership.
  • It involves deed drafting, correct stamp duty and registration fee, slot booking and appearing at the SRO.
  • Errors in the deed or valuation cause rejections, penalties and future title problems.
  • We handle drafting, duty calculation, slot booking and the SRO process end to end.
  • NRI-friendly, including guidance on Power of Attorney where you cannot attend in person.

Registering a property correctly is what converts a payment into legal ownership. Get the deed wording, the valuation or the stamp duty wrong, and you face rejection, penalties, or a defect that surfaces years later when you try to sell.

JaaGa manages the full registration — a properly drafted deed, correct stamp duty and fees, the Sub-Registrar slot, and the registration itself.

When You Need This Service

When buying, gifting or transferring any property and you want the deed and registration handled correctly.

When you are an NRI or out-of-town buyer who cannot navigate stamp duty, slot booking and the SRO in person.

The Registration Process

  1. 1

    Deed Drafting

    We draft the sale/gift/transfer deed with correct parties, schedule and clauses.

  2. 2

    Stamp Duty & Fees

    We compute stamp duty and registration fee on the correct market value and arrange payment.

  3. 3

    Slot Booking

    We book the Sub-Registrar Office appointment for registration.

  4. 4

    Registration & Delivery

    We coordinate the SRO appearance and deliver your registered, endorsed deed.

Documents Required

  • Agreement of sale / prior title deed
  • Identity and address proof of parties
  • PAN and photographs of parties
  • Property details, survey/plot number and value
  • Power of Attorney (if a party cannot attend)

Common Problems We Solve

Under-valuation penalties

Registering below the market/guidance value invites penalties. We value it correctly.

Defective deed clauses

Poorly drafted deeds cause future disputes. Our advocates draft it properly.

NRI attendance

When you can't attend, a valid POA is essential. We guide its correct execution.

Why Property Registration Service Matters

A property deal only becomes yours in law when it is registered correctly. Doing it right — proper deed, correct duty, valid execution — is what protects you from rejection today and from a title dispute a decade from now.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you draft the sale deed too?

Yes. Our advocates draft the deed with the correct schedule, parties and clauses before registration.

How is stamp duty calculated?

On the higher of the transaction value and the government market/guidance value, at the applicable Telangana rates. We compute it precisely.

Can an NRI register through Power of Attorney?

Yes, with a properly executed and, where required, adjudicated POA. We guide you through it.

What happens if I don't register?

An unregistered sale generally cannot establish ownership and is not admissible as evidence of title, leaving you legally exposed.

Do you handle gift and partition deeds?

Yes — sale, gift, partition and transfer deeds are all handled end to end.
